# Roadmaps, and a lesson that fits how you learn

no-vibe now calls your lesson plan a roadmap, asks how you like to learn, and researches your goal before planning.

## Breaking change

The lesson file is now `.no-vibe/ROADMAP.md`, and the old `.no-vibe/syllabus.md` is no longer read. To keep a lesson in progress, run this in that project before you resume:

```bash
mv .no-vibe/syllabus.md .no-vibe/ROADMAP.md
```

The reply header step is now `roadmap` instead of `syllabus`.

## What changed

- Roadmap. The plan of chapters is called a roadmap everywhere, in the file name, the header and the wording.
- Your learning style, asked. The agent always asks how you want to learn, code first, explanation first, a mix, or your own way, instead of guessing. It then teaches in that order. Your notes in `## Notes` still win if they say otherwise.
- Research scoped to your goal. Before writing the roadmap, the agent looks for existing roadmaps toward the same goal, such as learning paths, course outlines or roadmap.sh, then searches for anything else your goal needs, as often as it takes. Every search stays on your goal. It checks its plan against what it found, adds missing prerequisites, drops what you do not need, and fixes the order. Other roadmaps are only used to find gaps, never copied.
- README. The lesson walkthrough now describes the roadmap, the learning style question, optional chapters and what is saved for a fresh session.

## Upgrade

- Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace update no-vibe`, then restart.
- Codex: `codex plugin marketplace upgrade no-vibe`, then remove and add the plugin again.
- Pi: `pi install npm:no-vibe` once 4.0.0 is on npm, or `pi install git:github.com/rizukirr/no-vibe`.
- Antigravity: `agy plugin install https://github.com/rizukirr/no-vibe`.
- opencode: `opencode reload`.

Then rename any lesson in progress, as shown above.

Full changes: https://github.com/rizukirr/no-vibe/compare/v3.6.0...v4.0.0

# Continue any lesson in a fresh session

no-vibe now keeps a record of each section in `syllabus.md`, so a new session, or a different agent, can pick up your lesson knowing what you have already learned. Your own instructions on how to teach are kept too.

## What changed

- Sections planned when a chapter begins. The agent plans the chapter's sections up front and lists them under the chapter in `syllabus.md`, then teaches them in order. It can still change the sections still to come based on how you are doing.
- A record of what you learned. When a section ends, the agent ticks it and writes two lines under it: `Core:`, the 1 to 3 things you must remember, and `Saw:`, how it went. Chapters get a `Check:` line with the check result, and skipped chapters or sections are marked.
- Your notes, kept. `## Notes` in `syllabus.md` now holds what you asked the agent to change in how it teaches, such as "Explain code with comments inside the code" or "Write less text". The agent follows every note on every turn, including after a fresh start.
- Resume uses both. When you run `/no-vibe on` in a new session, the agent reads the section record and your notes before it continues.

## Upgrade

- Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace update no-vibe`, then restart.
- Codex: `codex plugin marketplace upgrade no-vibe`, then remove and add the plugin again.
- Pi: `pi install npm:no-vibe` once 3.6.0 is on npm, or `pi install git:github.com/rizukirr/no-vibe`.
- Antigravity: `agy plugin install https://github.com/rizukirr/no-vibe`.
- opencode: `opencode reload`.

A lesson started on an earlier version still resumes. Its old notes stay where they are, and new sections are recorded the new way.

Full changes: https://github.com/rizukirr/no-vibe/compare/v3.5.1...v3.6.0

# Grounded plans, visual thinking, one command fewer

no-vibe now plans your lesson backward from your goal, teaches you how to think with each visual, and drops the challenge command.

## What changed

- Plans grounded in your goal. Before writing the syllabus, the agent works backward from your goal: what you must know to reach it, what you must know to learn each of those, down to what you already know. When it can reach the web, it checks the plan against the official documentation first and lists the sources in `syllabus.md` under `## References`.
- Required and optional chapters. Each chapter is marked required or optional, and prerequisite chapters sit under the chapter they serve. Before an optional chapter or section, the agent explains what it covers and why it is worth learning, then lets you choose to do it or skip it.
- Read more. When a source the agent read in your session covers an idea, it ends that part with a link to read more. It never gives a link it has not opened or found in a search in the same session.
- Visuals you can think with. The agent shows a visual whenever an idea has parts, steps, a flow, a layout or changing values. For each one it tells you how to read it, walks through it with you, shows how to use it to predict what happens, and gives you one picture to remember and redraw later. Visuals use Unicode box-drawing lines and arrows, with plain ASCII as the fallback.
- `/no-vibe-challenge` is removed on every runtime. Use `/no-vibe` for lessons, which end each chapter with a check.

## Upgrade

- Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace update no-vibe`, then restart.
- Codex: `codex plugin marketplace upgrade no-vibe`, then remove and add the plugin again.
- Pi: `pi install npm:no-vibe` once 3.5.1 is on npm, or `pi install git:github.com/rizukirr/no-vibe`. If you linked the prompts by hand from `INSTALL.pi.md`, delete `~/.pi/agent/prompts/no-vibe-challenge.md`, which now points at nothing.
- Antigravity: `agy plugin install https://github.com/rizukirr/no-vibe`.
- opencode: `opencode reload`.

Full changes: https://github.com/rizukirr/no-vibe/compare/v3.5.0...v3.5.1

# The agent chooses the visual

no-vibe no longer limits visuals to text diagrams. The agent now picks the kind of visual that best fits the idea and that your chat can display.

## What changed

- Any visual that fits. The agent decides what helps, with no fixed list of formats, shapes or widths.
- Fits your chat. Runtimes display different things, so the agent chooses what your current chat can show. When it is not sure how something will display, it uses a visual that reads fine as plain text.
- Stays in chat. Visuals are always part of the conversation, so there are no files to open.
- Still explained in words. The explanation makes sense without the visual, and the agent skips one that would only repeat the words.

## Upgrade

- Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace update no-vibe`, then restart.
- Codex: `codex plugin marketplace upgrade no-vibe`, then remove and add the plugin again.
- Pi: `pi install npm:no-vibe` once 3.5.0 is on npm, or `pi install git:github.com/rizukirr/no-vibe`.
- Antigravity: `agy plugin install https://github.com/rizukirr/no-vibe`.
- opencode: `opencode reload`.

Full changes: https://github.com/rizukirr/no-vibe/compare/v3.4.0...v3.5.0

# Text diagrams in explanations

no-vibe now draws a text diagram when a picture makes an idea easier to follow, right in chat, on every runtime.

## What changed

- Diagrams when they help. The agent adds a diagram when an idea has a shape it can draw: how parts connect, a memory layout, call order, the path of a request, or values changing over time.
- Plain text, in chat. Diagrams use plain characters in a code block, narrow enough for a terminal, so there is nothing to open or install.
- Matches the explanation. A diagram uses the same names and values as the explanation, and the agent explains it in words too.
- No filler. The agent skips a diagram that would only repeat the words.
- Everywhere it explains. The rule covers lessons, re-explanations after a miss and answers to your questions.

## Upgrade

- Claude Code: `/plugin marketplace update no-vibe`, then restart.
- Codex: `codex plugin marketplace upgrade no-vibe`, then remove and add the plugin again.
- Pi: `pi install npm:no-vibe` once 3.4.0 is on npm, or `pi install git:github.com/rizukirr/no-vibe`.
- Antigravity: `agy plugin install https://github.com/rizukirr/no-vibe`.
- opencode: `opencode reload`.

Full changes: https://github.com/rizukirr/no-vibe/compare/v3.3.0...v3.4.0
